title: From Code Generator to Engineering Companion: A Plant-aware Agent for PLC Programming
abstract: arXiv:2610.28160v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) coding remains a manual, IDE-centric task that demands constant context switching between documentation, project files, and code editors. Recent work has demonstrated that retrieval-augmented large language models can generate vendor-compliant Structured Text at high compilation rates \cite{pred}, yet these systems treat code generation as a one-shot pipeline: the engineer submits a query and receives code, with no persistent knowledge of the specific plant. We present a plant-aware conversational copilot that extends this paradigm in three directions: plant-specific context ingestion, a chat-first interaction model for explanation and debugging, and a graduated tool-access ladder from chat to deployment. The system is designed for real plant infrastructure and keeps the engineer in control of each step that produces real-world effects.

translated_title: 从代码生成器到工程助手：面向PLC编程的工厂感知智能体
translated_abstract: 可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）编程仍然是一项以IDE为中心的手动任务，工程师需要在文档、项目文件和代码编辑器之间频繁切换上下文。近期研究表明，检索增强的大语言模型能够以较高的编译通过率生成符合厂商规范的Structured Text代码，但这些系统将代码生成视为一次性流水线：工程师提交查询后获得代码，系统对特定工厂没有持久化的知识。我们提出了一个工厂感知的对话式编程助手，该系统在三个方向上扩展了这一范式：工厂特定上下文的摄取、以对话为先的解释与调试交互模式，以及从对话到部署的分级工具访问阶梯。该系统专为真实工厂基础设施设计，并确保工程师对每个会产生现实世界影响的步骤保持控制权。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个工厂感知的对话式PLC编程智能体，通过工厂特定上下文摄取、以对话为先的解释与调试交互模式，以及从聊天到部署的分级工具访问阶梯，将PLC编程从一次性代码生成升级为持续的工程辅助体验。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a plant-aware conversational copilot for PLC programming that extends one-shot code generation into a persistent engineering companion through plant-specific context ingestion, a chat-first interaction model for explanation and debugging, and a graduated tool-access ladder from chat to deployment, keeping engineers in control of every real-world-effecting step.
